identity: preferred-minus-other log-probability margin = internal reference margin + correction energy margin; common play macro and normalization cancel.
limitations: These selected-pair frequencies do not estimate the benefit of deleting the correction head over all actions or states.
Correction energies depend on shared encoder and projection features as well as the subset head weights; this does not identify a parameter cause.
A correct pair ranking does not establish a preferred global mode or a full-game win.
Train and held populations contain different games and states; reported percentages are descriptive, not a causal train/held contrast or a readiness gate.
reference_definition: Each evaluated model's trainable candidate/autoregressive play distribution before its subset energy correction; not the frozen base policy used by KL.
scope: Post-hoc descriptive decomposition of previously exposed, outcome-selected action pairs.
selection_rule: Matched training and held populations retain pairs whose alternative is the base mode and whose replayed teacher/alternative clear outcomes differ.
